title: Select from a native dropdown
instruction: Set the shipping country to Norway and press Apply.

not_comparable.pixels: headless Chrome does not paint the native select popup into screenshots, so a screenshot-only planner cannot see the options (keyboard entry after focusing the select is its only path)
not_comparable.pixels+snap: headless Chrome does not paint the native select popup into screenshots, so a screenshot-only planner cannot see the options (keyboard entry after focusing the select is its only path)

notes: Kept in the suite because the accessibility path (set_value on the combobox) is a real capability worth measuring; see dropdown_custom for the fair three-way comparison.
